description: Cybercrime complaints. The narratives are invented and describe no actual incident.

records.narrative_raw: Complainant states that funds were debited from the account after an unsolicited call from a person claiming to be bank staff. The caller asked for a verification code which the complainant provided. Transaction reference quoted by the complainant is TXN-V-0001.
Complainant transferred money in response to an online advertisement promising guaranteed monthly returns. No returns were received and the contact number is no longer in service.

metadata_json.note: No transaction reference and no named suspect. This is the common case, and it is why the correlation tiers below tier 2 exist at all.

records.narrative_raw: Complainant reports an unrecognised debit. No further detail was available at the time of filing.

metadata_json.note: Deliberately thin. A complaint that correlates to nothing is a normal outcome and must not be presented as a failed match.

records.narrative_raw: Complainant was contacted through a messaging application by someone using the name of a relative and asking for an urgent transfer. The transfer was made to an account the complainant did not recognise.
